numerical_gate: Every Engine.state array and contact count bitwise equal after checkpoint reconstruction and two complete steps; no contact loss/reordering, force/slip change or tolerance relaxation.
performance_gate: Descriptive only; no minimum speedup gate. Warm execution only, construction, compilation, checkpoint reconstruction, state readback and diagnostics excluded.
revision: Both variants use one worker and verified cached BVH bounds/deferred normal loads. Candidate checks all existing outward-rounded hull plane groups for points and transformed source-cluster boxes; original directional group first. Original concave triangles determine every retained distance/normal. No preprocessing or contact operator changes. Descriptive timing, no speed threshold.
